name: Cleanfeed
tagline: Cleanfeed is a browser-based remote recording platform used by radio producers, podcasters, and audio engineers to capture studio-quality audio from guests anywhere in the world. Its AI noise gate and audio processing chain ensures clean, consistent recordings across different microphones and room acoustics.
